🎉 গণেশ উৎসব ২০২৩ — শুভ সূচনা

The 2023 celebration marked the proud beginning of the Sandeshkhali Ganesh Puja Committee. Families from every corner of the village came together, the mandap glowed with decorations, and the air rang with dhak and mantra all 5 days.

🥁

Dhak & Dhol

Traditional drummers played from dawn to dusk

🙏

Daily Puja

Morning and evening aarti attended by hundreds

🏏

Cricket Match

Exciting cricket match between village teams

🤸

Sports Events

Bhar Bhanga & Jamon Khusi Tamon Sajo competition

🍱

Bhog Distribution

Khichuri bhog served to all on Day 3 & Day 5

🏆

Prize Distribution

Awards presented to all competition winners

🕉 About the Festival

Shri Ganesh Utsav is one of the most beloved festivals of Sandeshkhali village, celebrated every year during the auspicious month of January–February. The festival spans 5 days and brings together every family in the village in prayer, celebration, and community spirit.

📍 Village Details

🏘
Village: Sandeshkhali
📆
Festival Duration: 5 Days
📅
Month: January–February
👥
Participation: All 500+ village families
🏛
Address: Sandeshkhai North 24 Paraganas 7 No. Nutunpara (Tiplegheri)

🎯 About This Website

This website is a digital memory archive for our village Ganesh Puja celebrations. Visitors can:

  • Browse photos and memories year by year
  • Discover highlights and events from each year's festival
  • Feel connected to the village even from far away

No login is required to browse. Every villager is welcome to contribute their story and photos to keep our memories alive forever.
